name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the library?

prefix.description: The prefix of the library. Native Nest mode only (requires project).

language.description: Nest library language. Nx-native libraries currently support ts only.

path.description: The path to create the library. Native Nest mode only (requires project).

rootDir.description: The libraries root directory. Native Nest mode only (requires project).

specFileSuffix.description: Specifies the file suffix of spec files.

format.description: Format generated files using Prettier if available.

project.description: Nx project owning the existing Nest workspace. Supply exactly one of project or directory.

skipInstall.description: Skip the workspace dependency install after generation.

directory.description: Workspace-relative destination for a new independent Nx library/package. Supply exactly one of project or directory.
